changelog: Fixes broken-image icons on every ready-made channel suggestion's thumbnail: a studio suggestion often borrows a Studio library item, and a studio-images provider commonly gives it a Banner or Backdrop rather than a Primary picture, which was the only kind asked for. The thumbnail now tries Primary, Thumb, Banner and Backdrop in turn, and a picture that still fails to load falls back to the same placeholder already used for no artwork at all. Also fixes two library items for the same film - a plain copy and a separately organised "(4K)" one, most often - showing up as two separate search results when adding content: now shown once, matched by the library's own provider id rather than by name.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
